blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Engine overheating may have caused the fire that hit a fast craft traveling from Cebu City to Ormoc City in Leyte on Sunday, authorities said. Regulators from the Marine Industry Authority (MARINA) have already suspended MV Oceanjet 168’s safety certificate while investigations are ongoing. The vessel reportedly caught fire while navigating waters off Compostela in northern Cebu past 10 a.m. on Sunday, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said.
